title: Uruguay — Rural Cadastral Parcels
description:
Cadastral parcels for rural Uruguay, updated as of February 2, 2025. 250,074 polygons with national coverage.

`PADRON` is the parcel number, and it is **not unique**. 250,074 rows carry 65,605 distinct `PADRON` values, and 242,899 distinct (`CODDEPTO`, `PADRON`) pairs, so a parcel number repeats both nationally and inside a department. Deduplicate before you count.

Attributes include department name (`NOMDEPTO`), department code (`CODDEPTO`), cadastral office (`NOMOFIDEL`), parcel number (`PADRON`), cadastral section (`SECCAT`), sheet and grid references (`LAMINA`, `CUADRICULA`), area in hectares (`AREAHA`), area in square metres (`AREAMC`) and assessed value (`VALREAL`).
